column1: # Partition table for a firmware that bmorcelli/Launcher can install.
# The Launcher occupies app0 (test) at 0x10000. This app links into
# app1 (ota_0) at 0x170000 and is capped at 0x4F0000. Offsets match
# so a dual-screen launcher and this bin agree on the slot.
# Building at the wrong offset boots garbage. This is not a flash script.
